title: {enemy:raider}
text:
前面有个{enemy:raider}，一把小刀，不难对付。

经验值是这样涨的：打赢一场就涨；奉了{faith:brute}，挨了打再用【怒气】打回去、低血打赢，各再多给一点 —— 输了没有打赢那份，已经做到的照给。

打完把鼠标停到顶端栏的徽记上看看。

texts.en:
A {enemy:raider} up ahead. One small knife. Not much trouble.

Here's how XP grows. Every battle won adds some. While you follow {faith:brute}, taking hits and striking back with Rage, or winning at low Health, each add a little more. A loss gives no win bonus, but what you did still counts.

After the fight, hover over the emblem in the top bar and have a look.

options.label: 进入战前准备
options.hint_when_hidden: 先把{item:charm_brute}放进包里（按 {key:B} 打开背包；留在上一个点的话，回去拿），右键它点「奉为主信仰」，信了{faith:brute}再打。

hints_when_hidden.en: Put the {item:charm_brute} in your bag first (press {key:B} to open your pack; if you left it at the last spot, go back for it), then right-click it and press Make main faith. Follow {faith:brute}, then fight.
